name: Iitaka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Iitaka town emblem in green: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised letter A.
history: Flag of the former town of Iitaka in Mie Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-01-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1966.

features.role: Iitaka town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised letter A
